integrity: The theorem and proof concern a newly formulated exact finite-block histogram; literature sequences for p=1,d=1 are acknowledged and not represented as newly derived data.
scientific_limitations: Positive coprime p,q with q>=2; fixed-fiber densities at fixed q; no irrational-slope or joint-growth assertion. Priority is qualified by possible unindexed historical equivalents; finite checks are not infinite proofs.
title: Numerator-independent gcd histograms for rational floor dilations
